_comment: 443.101 R2 — per-column register of *_id columns that CANNOT take a foreign key, each with its kind and reason. Shrink-only: an entry whose column no longer appears (or gained an FK) fails the guard until removed. Kinds are name-checked (external_id must name an external system, display_label must be a display id, authorization_code must be auth_id, tombstone_id must be merged_*, polymorphic must name a type column present in the same migration). Everything else is a missing FK — add it.
